chapter: Marge Singleton's St. Louis memories of Jelly Roll
title: Marge on Jelly playing the Nickelodeon piano and gambling with her brother
summary: Marge recalls Jelly Roll as the Nickelodeon piano player in St. Louis who gambled with her brother and was known through the Hawkins brothers.
